headline: Spar Warns of Nearly 50% Profit Drop as Credit Losses More Than Double
summary: Spar warned that headline earnings per share from continuing operations are expected to fall by between 44.5% and 49.5%, as retailer credit losses more than doubled.
why: Spar operates major retail networks; sharp drops in earnings coupled with escalating consumer credit losses highlight severe retail credit stress.

impacts.name: Spar Group Ltd
impacts.why: A forecasted profit drop of up to 49.5% directly reduces the fundamental equity value of the retailer.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The sharp downward revision in earnings guidance combined with doubling credit losses severely impacted investor confidence.
